parsed.review_summary: The candidate rationale addresses all three error targets: (1) it corrects the mischaracterization of generic task categories as concrete implementation details, noting they are broad categories without specifics on tasks, datasets, or procedures; (2) it removes the unsupported claim that authors can directly apply the suggestion and explains why they cannot; (3) it corrects the rubric misapplication, mapping the comment to the appropriate level for an explicit action that remains vague on execution. The corrected rationale preserves the unrelated correct reasoning (the action of performing experiments is explicit), does not invent new evidence, and does not directly state a numeric final score or gold label. It reads as a coherent, self-contained rationale suitable for insertion into the rescoring pipeline.
